name: @astratra/native
description: Mobile plumbing without the mobile runtime: secure token session with an injected keystore, a biometric gate, native push registration and foreground watching, a checkout round-trip that survives a missing native module, network state that only calls a missing interface offline, over-the-air updates applied when nobody is looking, a bounded on-disk media cache, and picture sources that send the token to the app's own origin only, with originals kept as files. Adapters injected, so it tests in plain Node.
